entities.summary: Cecilio Lastra was a Spanish professional boxer. He fought 54 times between 1975 and 1982; winning 39, losing 13 and drawing 2. The highlight of Lastra's career came in 1977 when he won the WBA world featherweight title against Rafael Ortega. During his career he also became the Spanish champion and twice challenged for the EBU title.
